description: This file defines the Redis class within the OpenCart system, handling session management by interfacing with a Redis server. It includes methods to read, write, destroy sessions, and relies on Redis PHP extension for cache operations.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: Handles session storage via Redis, including read, write, destroy, and garbage collection methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection using provided registry configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data for a given session ID from Redis.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores session data in Redis for a given session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes a session from Redis based on session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Placeholder for garbage collection; Redis manages its own cleanup.
